moderation.hiddenHint: The community can no longer see it, and the open reports about it are settled. “Restore” undoes both.
moderation.actionFailedHint: Nothing about the post changed. Reload the page and try again.

assist.failedHint: The AI access may not be set up, or the service is unreachable right now. The assessment is only a hint — the decision is yours either way.

trustLevels.title: Trust levels
trustLevels.description: Members earn levels 1 to 3 themselves — from time spent here, posts of their own, and the upvotes they give and receive. Level 4 is yours to grant: it may retitle and recategorise other people’s topics, pin, close and mark them solved, and edit other people’s posts. Listed here is everyone who has written something in this community.
trustLevels.confirmRevokeText: {name} loses level 4 and goes back to {level}. The badge stays.
trustLevels.selfAppoint: You cannot appoint yourself — you already hold these rights.
trustLevels.noCounters: This person has not written anything in this community yet.
trustLevels.saveFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
trustLevels.truncated: There are more members than shown here. Search for a name to find someone.
trustLevels.emptyText: As soon as someone writes or votes here, they appear in this list.
